fields.Name: cleanup
fields.purpose: CONTROL AND LATEST STATUS — Lists every base table and its purpose. Checked owned tables participate in new-show cleanup; only checked heartbeat/run-logs/errs-log participate in 1,000/500 quick cleanup. Records is the table count at action start; action results and archive/delete counts show the latest cleanup. History is in cleanup-logs.

fields.Name: errs-log
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Records individual source, identity, stage and logging errors, with class/trip/group IDs when available.

fields.Name: live-entries
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Stores collected trip and entry observations, including horse/rider/trainer identities, order, scratch, gone and placing. Entries reads Live downstream.

fields.Name: heartbeat
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Stamps the start and completion of each lane invocation to show cadence and outcome.

fields.Name: wef-schedules.schedules
fields.purpose: RETAINED REFERENCE — Synced schedules and existing native Live links. Not read by the current three-lane collection path; preserve existing links.

fields.Name: cleanup-logs
fields.purpose: PERMANENT ACTION LOG — Records each new-show or quick-cleanup table action, result, counts and archive location/hash. Never included in either cleanup rule.

fields.Name: collections
fields.purpose: RETAINED CATALOG — Keeps any previous collected-dataset and archive-file evidence and native collection links. Collection saves source evidence locally. The approved new cleanup catalogs its archives in cleanup-logs and never deletes this table.

fields.Name: live-groups
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Stores collected live groups, progress counts, ring/class links and Active/Absent/Dropped source membership.

fields.Name: wef-entries.entries
fields.purpose: RETAINED REFERENCE — Synced Entries records retained for existing native links/history. Live does not read Entries; Entries reads Live.

fields.Name: run-logs
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Records each lane's outcome, counts, collection/save timings and changed-business-field diffs.

fields.Name: live-class-appearances
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Stores each show/day/group/class appearance separately, with Active/Absent/Dropped membership and links to the group and unique class detail.

fields.Name: wef-shows.show
fields.purpose: RETAINED SYNC — Local copy of canonical show information. The current collector reads Shows.shows directly in wef-shows, not this local sync.

fields.Name: code-reviews
fields.purpose: ADMINISTRATIVE — Stores routine code-review dates, results and findings. Not a table read or written by the three collection lanes.

fields.Name: meta
fields.purpose: UNUSED BY COLLECTOR — Existing table with only a Name field; no references in the current three-lane collection path. No deletion approved.

fields.Name: wef-shows.show-days
fields.purpose: RETAINED SYNC — Local copy of canonical show days and day-priority. The current collector reads Shows.show-days directly in wef-shows, not this local sync.

fields.Name: live-rings
fields.purpose: ACTIVE — Stores collected ring observations and current, next and completed group links.
